{/* Our Story */}
Our Story

Born from a Real Problem

As students ourselves, we noticed a huge gap in the freelancing world. Platforms like Upwork and Fiverr are designed for professionals with years of experience. Students with fresh skills but no real-world portfolio had no place to start.

StudentHub was created to bridge this gap. We built an intelligent matching system that connects students with projects perfectly suited to their skill level — making it easier than ever to gain real experience.

Our platform is based on research from the paper "Job Recommender System for Freelancers", adapted specifically for the student ecosystem.
